comment: Written BEFORE any code reads SEVERITIES (the W discipline). v0.35 is the per-seat severity: SEVERITIES [seat: warning] on a DECLARATION, for a seat whose value is a reference (a DECLARATION, a UNION of declarations, a SYMBOL); SEVERITIES [word: warning] on unknown_declaration, for a NAMED word. A1-A8 accept; R1-R11 refuse, each by the fragment of why. A7 pins that nothing existing changes. The module docstring of gen_fixtures.py states the ask, the five warnings and Zin's granularity.

accepts.name: a reference to a declaration at warning
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE q AS (VERSION "0.35", GRAMMAR "0.35", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".q") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU roles AS (WORDS [primary, secondary], MESSAGE "a role") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SYMBOL entity AS (KIND "entity", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION target AS (OF [flow, form]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION form AS (VERB "FORM", SEATS [flow: flow?, flows: [flow]?, role: roles?, entity: entity?, target: target?, title: text?], SEVERITIES [flow: warning]) RATIONALE "x"
